name: Two Hands Shiraz Lily's Garden 2017
text:
## Two Hands Shiraz Lily's Garden 2017

**The story.** Two Hands was founded by Michael Twelftree and his partner Richard Mintz. Its Garden Series is a set of six Shirazes, each reflecting a different South Australian region, and each named after one of the founders' children; the vineyards are the "gardens" ([Wine Spectator](https://www.winespectator.com/articles/a-decade-of-bellas-garden-47721)).

**The wine: Lily's Garden.** Lily's Garden is the Garden Series Shiraz from [McLaren Vale](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_Vale). Wine Spectator found it has run "just a tick behind" Bella's Garden on average across vintages ([Wine Spectator](https://www.winespectator.com/articles/a-decade-of-bellas-garden-47721)). For 2017, Jeb Dunnuck reports 18 months in just 9% new French oak ([JJ Buckley, critics' notes](https://www.jjbuckley.com/wine/2017-two-hands-shiraz-lilys-garden/2017-202-750/)).

**From the history books**
- **Named for a McLaren.** McLaren Vale was named after either David McLaren, Colonial Manager of the South Australian Company, or John McLaren, who surveyed the area in 1839. The first settlers grew cereal crops, but John Reynell and Thomas Hardy planted vines in 1838, and the forerunners of today's Seaview and Hardys wineries were running by 1850 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_Vale)).
- **Century-old vines.** Some McLaren Vale vines more than 100 years old are still producing ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_Vale)), and the region is a member of the Great Wine Capitals of the World network.
- **Between the gulf and the hills.** The region runs 30 km down the coast of the [Gulf St Vincent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gulf_St_Vincent) to the foothills of the [Mount Lofty Ranges](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Lofty_Ranges), with a [Mediterranean climate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mediterranean_climate) of four clear seasons ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McLaren_Vale)).
- **Penfolds comes south.** Between 1904 and 1912 [Penfolds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penfolds), then the largest winery around Adelaide, bought vineyards in McLaren Vale ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penfolds)).

**The vintage.** [Jancis Robinson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jancis_Robinson)'s [South Australia vintage chart](https://www.jancisrobinson.com/learn/vintages/south-australia) says 2017 began cool and wet, which brought disease pressure but none of the drought problems of recent years; the crop was plentiful, and dry weather through most of the harvest kept quality generally high.

**What the critics say for 2017.** As listed by [JJ Buckley](https://www.jjbuckley.com/wine/2017-two-hands-shiraz-lilys-garden/2017-202-750/):
- **[Jeb Dunnuck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeb_Dunnuck): 96** (November 2019). "More reserved but no less brilliant": dark black fruit, damp herbs, scorched earth and obvious minerality; medium to full-bodied, "flawlessly balanced, textured, and seamless". "Up with the finest vintages I've tasted of this cuvée", for up to a decade.
- **[Wine Advocate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Wine_Advocate): 92** (Joe Czerwinski, June 2019). Ripe cherry with thyme and mint; creamy and ripe, turning silky, with a little oak structure.
- **[Wine Spectator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wine_Spectator): 91** (January 2020). Wild berry and plum with sage, bay leaf and brown sugar, thick and velvety, and blood orange on the finish. Drink now to 2029; 2,500 cases made.
- **[CellarTracker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CellarTracker) community: 91.1** (from your CellarTracker list).

**How it's drinking now.** In October 2026 the wine is nine years old. Dunnuck gave it up to a decade and Wine Spectator to 2029, so drink it over the next couple of years. Decant an hour ahead.

**Food.** Lamb shoulder with rosemary, grilled kangaroo or venison, or a pepper-crusted steak.

**Value and where to buy.** None of the stores on this site lists Two Hands at the moment.

Sources:
- [JJ Buckley, 2017 Lily's Garden (critics' notes)](https://www.jjbuckley.com/wine/2017-two-hands-shiraz-lilys-garden/2017-202-750/)
